Hi Amy — really appreciate the heads-up and the snapshot. High-level proposal attached; below is the ops-first summary so you can share with procurement and engineering.

Summary (TL;DR)
- Staged commit ladder: 3-month schedule: Month 1 = +1.5x baseline commit, Month 2 = +2.5x, Month 3+ = +3.0x with option to step down to 1.8x after 8 weeks.
- Canary: Built-in route-level canary for 10% traffic for first 7 days (no SDK change). We take the canary latency/cost metrics and auto-adjust routing.
- Burst credits: temporary burst pool we can assign immediately (subject to billing approval). We provide a one-time burst credit buffer equivalent to ~10% of expected peak tokens; this can be consumed and then we convert to an amendment if sustained.
- Fair-rate gating: implement a soft-headroom policy per API key: 95th-percentile smoothing window + progressive 429s with backoff headers (X-Redwood-Retry-After). This keeps UX intact while preserving latency SLOs.

Operational checklist (next steps)
1) We prepare a formal staged-commit amendment (attached v2) — procurement review.
2) Karthik will run a short canary run in our staging infra next week to validate KV cache behavior under longer sequences.
3) Marissa will propose SLA guardrails and a rollback plan (canary -> full -> rollback).
4) We provision temporary burst credits on your tenant the day the amendment is signed (DocuSign link provided after procurement greenlight).

Pricing note: The committed rate tiers will be pro-rated the first month and we recommend a blended effective rate for Month 1 to reduce admin. Procurement-related numbers are in the attached PDF.

I attached: redwood_staged_commit_proposal_v2.pdf (proposal + rate table) and the usage snapshot you sent (included).

Would love to jump on a 30-min call to walk through the plan with your ops and procurement. Availability this week: Tue/Thu 10–12 PT, Fri 1–3 PT.

Hi Amy — great call earlier. Recap and confirmed next steps below.

Recap
- Burst credits: provisioned at account level, but ops can reserve a percentage per route. We set up 12% of expected peak tokens as an account-level burst buffer; by policy we will funnel 70% of that to personalization routes and 30% to search during the initial 2-week ramp. No SDK changes.
- Canary: 10% traffic for 7 days. We'll use the longer smoothing window (72 hrs) for the first week to reduce spiky 429s; Retry-After will start at 10s and exponentiate up to 120s if repeated. We'll surface X-Redwood-Retry-After and X-Redwood-Headroom in responses.
- PO-based top-up: Marissa will coordinate with finance to accept a 30-day PO change for the initial burst. If usage remains above the amended commit after 30 days, we'll convert to the staged amendment (deal_id VR-2028-4291).

Attachments enclosed: redwood_staged_commit_proposal_v2.pdf (finalized for procurement), one-page SLA addendum draft, and the usage snapshot you shared.

- Dylan: prepare DocuSign for staged amendment; hold until PO outcome.
